name: Shirahama Asuka
source: A third-year student and the president of the Comic Club. Just like [url=/c14452]Kenjirou[/url], she's an otaku. Asuka is friendly, curious and slightly mischievous, and is known as a bit of a troublemaker in the campus.
translation: A third-year student and the president of the Comic Club. Just like [url=/c14452]Kenjirou[/url], she's an otaku. Asuka is friendly, curious and slightly mischievous, and is known as a bit of a troublemaker in the campus.
